title: Independent hydride-transfer barrier test for protonated bisphosphine 2a
difficulty_reasons: The reactant is fixed but the investigator must independently locate and validate a transition state and discriminate direct versus stepwise behavior.

paper.title: Protonated bisphosphines: a new class of powerful hydride donors capable of CO2 reduction

data.description: Self-contained XYZ geometry for 79-atom protonated bisphosphine 2a in the in-out conformer; charge +1 and singlet are stated in the task.

required_deliverables.description: Validated computational investigation and barrier/mechanism result.
